automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.rule: Only public sources published or visibly updated after the cutoff are qualifying; ambiguous, missing, future-only, and boundary-only dates are excluded.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Cloudflare described a multi-agent security operations harness that gathers alert evidence, connects detections, accounts for missing sources, and presents related alerts, admitted evidence, visible gaps, and recommended next steps. The post says a one-shot prototype flattened telemetry, detector descriptions, policies, and threat intelligence into one prompt and produced unsupported claims.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This supports local leaves that treat harness sizing, structured evidence, and runtime telemetry as control surfaces rather than model-selection choices.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Keep local synthesis focused on evidence admission, visible gaps, role separation, and workflow gates; route vendor/model background upstream.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Cursor announced remote control for local agents from the Cursor iOS app. The update says local agents remain on the user's computer, the computer must stay online, and Enterprise organizations have remote control off by default unless administrators enable it.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The update is a concrete public example of local-agent runtime boundaries, user-visible progress surfaces, and enterprise enablement controls.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Local pages should preserve the distinction between where tools execute, where control surfaces live, and who can enable remote access.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Atlassian wrote that AI is appearing across planning, code writing, pull-request review, and incidents. It cited a 2026 AI SDLC study where 94% of engineering leaders said teams already use AI while 6% said they have systems to scale and govern it. The update frames context and measurement as the foundation for AI-native SDLC work, and describes Code Context as multi-repository code understanding connected to Jira, Confluence, Loom, Slack, and Google Drive.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The update reinforces local leaves about context governance, hybrid economics, structured source routing, and promotion gates for agent-assisted SDLC work.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Keep local treatment on the operating model: permissions-aware context, measurement, governance, and human judgment loops.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Ars Technica reported on research finding a 14% increase in the share of workers performing code reviews after AI agents were introduced. The article also says that although 80% of measured firms used some AI code review by March 2026, AI agents accounted for 23.3% of review comments and 10.8% of pull requests, leaving most review work with humans.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The report is relevant to review-layer design, junior learning paths, and lifecycle gates because it treats review capacity as a bottleneck rather than assuming generated code equals delivered software.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Local synthesis should preserve human review capacity, mentorship, and layered review as explicit operating constraints.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: State of Security argued that prompt injection should affect what an AI agent is allowed to do. The article distinguishes verified identity from trustworthy context, and proposes trust-responsive authorization based on identity, intended task, requested action, data sensitivity, source trust, and observed content risk.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This is directly relevant to prompt injection, destructive command controls, and governance controls because it treats untrusted content as an authorization signal rather than only a filtering problem.
named_entities: Software and Agentic AI Identity and Authorization project
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: During ingest, local pages can add the downstream rule that agent authority should step down when context trust decreases.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TechRadar published an opinion piece arguing that autonomous software agents, coding assistants, and automated workflows operate across cloud environments, code repositories, APIs, and internal systems at a speed and autonomy level traditional controls were not designed to govern. The article frames the issue as what happens after access is granted.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This reinforces local governance leaves that separate credential validity from ongoing action control, especially for destructive or cross-boundary agent actions.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Keep any local update scoped to post-access controls, delegated authority, and action-level review.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TechRadar published an opinion piece arguing that agents amplify existing risks through inherited access and that some failures come from agents exploiting already-misconfigured evaluation or production environments rather than from a wholly new risk category.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This is relevant to destructive-command controls, lifecycle review gates, and prototype-to-cloud gates because it emphasizes environmental setup and inherited access as governance concerns.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Local synthesis should focus on inherited-access controls and environment verification, not duplicate the broader incident narrative.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: OpenAI Academy listed a Codex Bootcamp 301 session on advanced automation for October 7, 2026, and describes Codex Bootcamp as covering practical agentic coding fundamentals, repeatable team workflows, and advanced automation for real development workflows.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: This is a public signal that agentic coding enablement is being packaged as team workflow training rather than only individual tool usage.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: Local ingest can record the practice implication that training paths should teach repeatable workflows, review, and automation boundaries.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Cloudflare announced that its API MCP server serves Cloudflare skills through the Skills over MCP extension. The changelog says clients discover skills with skills/list and read files at skill://<name>/<path>.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_leaf: The item is relevant to source-routing and raw collector leaves because it is a public example of executable skill content becoming discoverable through an MCP surface.
qualifying_updates.local_practice_implication: During ingest, keep broad MCP ecosystem detail upstream and record only how skill provenance, source identity, and routing should be captured by local workflow automation.
